title.narrative: Xinjiang Municipal Infrastructure and Environmental Improvement Project

description.narrative:
The impact of the Project is sustained socioeconomic growth and improved living standards in the border areas of north XUAR (Altay Administrative District, Boertala Mongolian Autonomous Prefecture, and Yili Kazak Autonomous Prefecture). The outcome is improved municipal infrastructure and a better living and ecological environment in Alashankou Land Port, Kanas Scenic Region and Yining City.
The Project has three components broken down into 13 subcomponents. The three components are (i) Component I: Yining City roads and municipal services, (ii) Component II: Alashankou Land Port municipal infrastructure and environmental protection and (iii) Component III: Kanas Scenic Region infrastructure and environmental protection. The Project also provides for institutional development and capacity building to ensure effective implementation of the Project and sustainable operations and maintenance of the project facilities.
The Project will also be complemented by a Gender and Development Fund-financed grant ($150,000) for the Kanas Women's Enterprise Development Project, which is aimed to support activities on capacity building in local tourism and demonstration projects in health and hygiene for ethnic minority women in the Kanas component of the Project.

description.narrative: Improved municipal infrastructure, and a better living and ecological environment in Alashankou land port, Kanas scenic region, and Yining City.
20% of increased 1,500 jobs in KSR is for women. Data Source: Social economic statistics; annual statistics reports Actual value:

Increased employment with the creation of 1,600 jobs for local people in Yining, including at least 20% for women. Progress/Status: A total of 1,620 jobs created by the project as of end 2009. Data Source: Social economic statistics; annual statistics reports Actual value:

Increased employment with the creation of 1,600 jobs in Alashankou. Progress/Status: As of end 2010, 500 jobs have been created. Data Source: Social economic statistics; annual statistics reports Actual value:

Wastewater treatment increased from 0% to 80% in Alashankou. Progress/Status: Will be evaluated when the WWTP is put into operation. Data Source: Records of environmental protection bureaus Actual value:

Annual freight traffic of Alashankou land port increased from 11.2 million tons to 24.0 million tons. Progress/Status: As of end 2010, annual freight traffic was 25.24 million tons. Data Source: Annual statistics reports Actual value:
Public transport routes increased from 14 to 24 in Yining. Progress/Status: As of end 2010, 21 routes with 425 fleets. Data Source: Records of public transport companies Actual value:

Collection and treatment of domestic garbage increased from 15% to 60% in KSR. Progress/Status: Will be evaluated when the sanitation landfill is put into operation. Data Source: Records of environmental protection bureaus Actual value:

Employment increased from 1,700 jobs to 3,200 jobs in KSR. Progress/Status: As of end 2010, employment increased to 2,300 jobs. Data Source: Social economic statistics; annual statistics reports Actual value:

Potable water coverage of the three project villages increased from 20% to 70% in KSR. Progress/Status: will be evaluated when the water supply plant is put into operation. Data Source: Project progress reports; internal and external monitoring reports Actual value:

Wastewater collection increased from 20% to 65% in KSR. Progress/Status: Will be evaluated when the sanitation landfill is put into operation. Data Source: Records of environmental protection bureaus Actual value:
Green space expanded from 270 hectares to 610 hectares in Alashankou Progress/Status: ongoing Data Source: Annual statistics reports Actual value:

Residents' satisfaction with the environment increased from 30% to 60% in Kanas Scenic Region (KSR). Progress/Status: A survey will be conducted by project compleition. Data Source: Social opinion surveys Actual value:

Running water supply coverage increased from 53% to 90% in Alashankou. Progress/Status: Will be evaluated when the water supply plant is put into operation Data Source: Annual statistics reports Actual value:

Wastewater collection and treatment increased from 65% to 80% in Yining. Progress/Status: Will be evaluated when the WWTP is put into operation. Data Source: Records of environmental protection bureaus Actual value:

Number of poor people decreased from 900 to 400 in KSR. Progress/Status: As of end 2010, number of poor people reduced to 830. Data Source: Social economic statistics; annual statistics reports; internal and external monitoring survey reports Actual value:
